name: Kitsune light punch
notes: Medium-punch cross clip played at 2x (F5, designer-approved). Clip-derived 4/6/23 vs C8 4/2/7: startup matches C8, active is 4 longer and recovery 16 longer because the clip keeps the whole cross. Hurtbox: the E5 standing body 90x360 for the whole move; the wide sleeves are NOT added (they are cloth, not body); only the bare striking limb gets an extra hurtbox while it is extended. Hitstun, blockstun and pushback are placeholders on the Ryo fixture scale (not in rules.md); damage is the C8 number (no Kitsune table exists). Provisional clip file; swap to the retake clip when it lands.
